title: sdk-triad-auth-convergence-add-ergonomic-retry-presets-and-crosslang-docs
author: Ava Thompson
release_notes: Introduce a converged auth shape + retry presets across Python/TS/Go SDKs; add explanatory docs and a cross-SDK CI matrix. Non-breaking; improves ergonomics and reduces flakiness in streaming integrations.
description:
Context: Multiple SDK teams have independently evolved auth and stream retry ergonomics which caused subtle surface mismatches and test flakiness for cross-language examples. This PR aligns token/session shapes, provides production-oriented retry presets, and ships explanatory docs + a CI matrix that runs representative auth+stream integration tests across Python/TypeScript/Go.

Motivation: reduce cognitive overhead for integrators, remove accidental incompatibilities when clients switch languages, and reduce production incidents caused by inconsistent default backoffs.

Work items and checklist:
- Implement a small, explicit auth adapter interface that each SDK implements (allows language idioms while preserving a common semantic contract).
- Add three retry presets (interactive, batch, streaming) encoded as tiny config blobs consumed by sdks.
- Provide a lightweight session-lease example and canonical docs with migration steps.
- Add cross-sdk GH Actions matrix to run a minimal auth+stream integration suite on PRs to sdk-convergence paths.
- Fix flaky streaming test by switching to deterministic timeout hooks and stronger telemetry assertions.

Checklist:
- [x] Auth adapter interfaces implemented in Python/TS/Go
- [x] Retry presets added and documented
- [x] End-to-end smoke tests added to the cross-SDK CI matrix
- [x] Docs, examples, and migration notes written
- [x] Telemetry tags standardized for retry reason and auth-mode

Summary of changes (high level):
- Core: Introduced AuthAdapter contract and minimal adapter impls for each SDK allowing token refresh, lease, and explicit invalidate calls.
- Retry: Added preset profiles and a small BackoffFactory that maps profile names to durable retry strategies; used by streaming consumer helpers.
- Tests/CI: New cross-sdk GH Actions workflow (sdk-cross-matrix.yml) and lightweight integration tests exercising auth refresh + stream resume.
- Docs/examples: docs/sdks/auth-convergence.md and examples/multi-sdk/cred-quickstart updated with step-by-step migration instructions and a troubleshooting section.
- Telemetry: standardized retry_reason and auth_mode tags across SDKs to make rollouts and incidents filterable.

Why this is safe/low-risk: The default behavior is conservative (existing defaults preserved unless a preset name is supplied). The adapter is opt-in for older integrators; migration notes show a two-line change in client bootstrap. Tests added to matrix reduce risk of regressions across languages.
